column2: I'm so drawn to your eyes...
When you look at me, it feels like a warmth I'd forgotten is coming back...
Of course you hate me... But!
You're going to stay with me... forever!
When I saw you $$大ケガ$$, I thought my heart would break.
If you died... I wondered what I would do...
If you're by my side, I don't need anything else.
You hate me, don't you? Me...
